title: Bounded and measurable common fundamental domains for two lattices
summary: Suppose that $L, M$ are two full-rank lattices in Euclidean space with $\text{vol}(L)=\text{vol}(M)$. We give a new proof on the existence of a bounded and Lebesgue measurable set that tiles $\mathbb{R}^d$ with both $L,M$ using the measurable Hall's Theorem which was proved by T.Ciésla and M. Sabok. This proof is direct and does not go through the intermediate results on cut-and-project sets involved in the proof given by S.Grepstad and M.Kolountzakis.
